The official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was 3 November 2025. Moss's 11/2 Coastal digest says the account "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03," and your 8 December 2025 cutover recap agrees.

For the tracker, use 2025-11-03 as the official date. Kwame fully took over day to day on 22 November, after you stepped out on 21 November. I replied in the #coastal-team thread.
